name: Network Graph
summary: Relationship map from an edge list plus an optional node table — customers, suppliers, competitors and partners around the target; force or circular layout with zoom, drag and adjacency highlight.
summary_zh: 由边表（可选节点表）生成的关系网络：围绕目标公司的客户、供应商、竞争对手与合作伙伴；力导向或环形布局，支持缩放、拖拽与邻接高亮。
description_zh: 主数据集是边表（source、target、value、type），节点信息通过 options.nodesData 绑定另一个数据集（id、name、类别、规模）；没有节点表时自动从边推导节点。节点颜色代表类别（图例可开关），节点面积代表规模，连线粗细代表金额，目标公司以强调色突出。力导向布局使用确定性初始位置，每次打开与打印结果一致。悬停节点会高亮其直接关系，点击节点可保持聚焦并交叉筛选；Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮或双指捏合缩放（普通滚轮照常滚动页面），拖动画布与节点。适合 10–80 个节点的生态图、客户/供应商依赖、董事交叉任职、投资人关系等。
best_for: Ecosystem map: customers / suppliers / competitors / partners around the target
avoid_when: More than ~150 nodes (aggregate or use a matrix)
Precise value comparison (use a bar chart)

edgeType.desc: Relationship type shown in tooltips; can be dashed via dashedTypes (edge dataset)

size.desc: Node size → symbol area (nodesData); defaults to the sum of linked edge values

nodesData.desc: Dataset id of the node table (one row per node); nodes are derived from edges when null

layout.desc: force: deterministic spring layout solved before paint (print-identical), nudged so labels clear other nodes | circular: nodes at equal angular steps around the dominant highlighted hub (centre), categories contiguous | physics: live ECharts force simulation

highlight.desc: Node id(s) or name(s) drawn in accent2 (e.g. the target company)

categoryColors.desc: {category: colour} — theme token ('accent', 'cat3' …) or CSS colour

labels.desc: auto: label the largest nodes (+ highlighted) | true | false. Each label takes the free side facing away from the hub (right / left / above / below / diagonal) on a paper chip; a label with no free position is hidden and shows on hover

labelTop.desc: Number of labelled nodes when labels = 'auto'

nodeSize.desc: Symbol diameter range in px (sqrt scale on size)

edgeWidth.desc: Edge width range in px (linear on value)

edgeColor.desc: auto (colour of the non-highlighted end — reads well for hub-and-spoke) | source | target | neutral

edgeCurve.desc: Edge curvature for the force layout (circular uses 0.25)

dashedTypes.desc: Edge types drawn dashed (listed in the edge key). House style reserves dashes for reference lines: prefer edgeColor to tell relationship types apart

edgeKey.desc: Edge key beside the category legend (top-left): line-width scale with min / max value, plus any dashed edge types

force.desc: layout 'physics' only: ECharts force overrides {repulsion, edgeLength, gravity, friction}; defaults scale with the container and node count

roam.desc: Zoom (Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch) and drag to pan

wheelZoom.desc: true: zoom on a plain mouse wheel; default: a plain wheel scrolls the page and a hint shows the Ctrl/⌘ + wheel shortcut

hideIsolated.desc: With nodesData: drop nodes left without edges by the current filters

format.desc: Edge value format; defaults to the value field's format

crossFilter.desc: Click a node to keep its neighbourhood in focus and filter other blocks on the source field

crossFilterScope.desc: dataset: the selection only filters blocks bound to the same edge dataset ('source' / 'target' are generic names) | global

filterScope.desc: Deprecated alias of crossFilterScope (still honoured when set)

interactions: Hover a node: adjacency highlight + tooltip (category, size, connections)
Hover an edge: relationship type and value
Click a node to pin its neighbourhood and cross-filter
Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom (a plain wheel scrolls the page), drag to pan, drag nodes
Positions are kept across filter updates
